sections.h2: Culpepper Landing Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 104 residential sales closed in Culpepper Landing (Chesapeake, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $538,500, above the citywide median of $420,000, and homes took a median of 29 days to sell, slower than the citywide median of 18 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Culpepper Landing sales closed between $382,000 and $580,000, or about $209 per square foot against $219 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($550,000, 49 sales) was about 3% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($534,900, 55 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Culpepper Landing sales were in ZIP code 23323.

sections.h2: What Stands Out About Culpepper Landing
sections.html: 48% of the homes sold here were built in 2015 or later; across Chesapeake the figure is 24%. The median Culpepper Landing home is about 2,460 square feet, larger than the 1,970 square foot citywide median. 66% of Culpepper Landing sales had four or more bedrooms, against 53% citywide.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Culpepper Landing

71% of the sales were detached homes and 29% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 2,460 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,923 to 2,894 square feet. 39% of the homes that sold had 4 bedrooms.
